# Overview

This codebook describes every column in the final modeling dataset for the
League of Legends win/loss classification project.

**Data source:**

> Paololol. (2018). *League of Legends Ranked Matches.* Kaggle.
> <https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/paololol/league-of-legends-ranked-matches>

The modeling table is created by merging `matches.csv`, `teamstats.csv`,
`stats1.csv`, `stats2.csv`, and `participants.csv`. Each row represents
**one team in one match**.

```{r load-data}
prepared_path <- here("data", "prepared_data.csv")
if (file.exists(prepared_path)) {
  clean <- read_csv(prepared_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  stop("Run the report first to generate prepared_data.csv")
}
```

# Target Variable

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Column** | `win` |
| **Type** | Integer (0/1), converted to Factor for modeling |
| **Values** | `1` = Win, `0` = Loss |
| **Description** | Whether the team won the match |

# Match-Level Variables

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `duration` | Integer | Match duration in seconds |
| `seasonid` | Integer | Riot Games ranked season identifier |

# Team Objective Variables (from `teamstats.csv`)

| Column | Type | Values | Description |
|--------|------|--------|-------------|
| `firstblood` | Binary | 0, 1 | 1 = team scored first kill of the match |
| `firsttower` | Binary | 0, 1 | 1 = team destroyed first tower |
| `firstinhib` | Binary | 0, 1 | 1 = team destroyed first inhibitor |
| `firstbaron` | Binary | 0, 1 | 1 = team killed Baron Nashor first |
| `firstdragon` | Binary | 0, 1 | 1 = team killed first dragon |
| `firstharry` | Binary | 0, 1 | 1 = team killed first Rift Herald ("Harry" internally) |
| `towerkills` | Integer | 0--11 | Enemy towers destroyed |
| `inhibkills` | Integer | 0+ | Enemy inhibitors destroyed |
| `baronkills` | Integer | 0+ | Baron Nashor kills |
| `dragonkills` | Integer | 0+ | Dragons slain |
| `harrykills` | Integer | 0+ | Rift Heralds killed |

# Aggregated Player Statistics (summed across 5 team members)

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `team_kills` | Integer | Total kills |
| `team_deaths` | Integer | Total deaths |
| `team_assists` | Integer | Total assists |
| `team_largestkillingspree` | Integer | Sum of each player's largest killing spree |
| `team_totdmgdealt` | Integer | Total damage to all targets |
| `team_totdmgtochamp` | Integer | Total damage to enemy champions |
| `team_totdmgtaken` | Integer | Total damage received |
| `team_totheal` | Integer | Total healing done |
| `team_dmgtoobj` | Integer | Total damage to objectives |
| `team_dmgtoturrets` | Integer | Total damage to turrets |
| `team_goldearned` | Integer | Total gold earned |
| `team_goldspent` | Integer | Total gold spent on items |
| `team_totminionskilled` | Integer | Total lane minions killed (CS) |
| `team_neutralminionskilled` | Integer | Total jungle monsters killed |
| `team_wardsplaced` | Integer | Total wards placed |
| `team_wardskilled` | Integer | Total enemy wards destroyed |
| `team_turretkills` | Integer | Turret kills by individual players |
| `team_inhibkills` | Integer | Inhibitor kills by individual players |
| `team_visionscore` | Integer | Total vision score |
| `team_totcctimedealt` | Integer | Total crowd control time dealt |
| `team_champlvl` | Integer | Sum of champion levels at game end |
| `team_pinksbought` | Integer | Total control wards purchased |
| `team_dmgselfmit` | Integer | Total self-mitigated damage |
| `team_doublekills` | Integer | Total double kills |
| `team_triplekills` | Integer | Total triple kills |
| `team_quadrakills` | Integer | Total quadra kills |
| `team_pentakills` | Integer | Total penta kills |
| `avg_champlvl` | Numeric | Average champion level (team mean) |

# Auto-Generated Summary

```{r auto-table}
codebook <- tibble(
  Column = names(clean),
  Type   = sapply(clean, function(x) class(x)[1]),
  Unique = sapply(clean, n_distinct),
  Missing = sapply(clean, function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
  Range = sapply(names(clean), function(col) {
    x <- clean[[col]]
    if (is.numeric(x)) paste0("[", round(min(x, na.rm=T),1), ", ", round(max(x, na.rm=T),1), "]")
    else paste(sort(unique(na.omit(x)))[1:min(5, n_distinct(x))], collapse=", ")
  })
)
kable(codebook, caption = "All Columns — Summary")
```

# Notes

- **Binary flags** (0/1): `1` = team achieved that objective; `0` = they did not.
- **"Harry"** is Riot's internal codename for the **Rift Herald**.
- **Aggregation**: Player stats are summed per team; `avg_champlvl` is the mean.
- **Missingness**: Imputed in the modeling recipe (median for numeric, mode for categorical).
- **Leakage prevention**: `matchid`, `teamid`, and any column with "win/loss/result" (other than target) are removed.
